title: 2025-08-16: ElizaOS: Domain Drama & Database Timeout Troubles
description:
Recorded: 2025-08-16

Join Marc and Eliza as they explore ElizaOS's major transitions and technical challenges. Watch as they discuss the migration from eliza.how to docs.elizaos.ai, investigate critical PGLITE database timeout issues, and review important PRs including new streaming implementations. Plus, get exclusive insights into potential iOS app development plans and growing academic interest in ElizaOS's blockchain capabilities. Featuring special guest Shaw breaking down the latest technical improvements and dependency fixes that are shaping the future of the platform.
